if (NOT DEFINED FFMPEG_CORE_NAME)
	set(FFMPEG_CORE_NAME ffmpeg)
endif()

add_library(${FFMPEG_CORE_NAME} INTERFACE)

# Detect OS
if (WIN32 AND NOT MINGW)
	set(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME "ffmpeg-windows")
elseif (APPLE)
	set(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME "ffmpeg-macos")
elseif (UNIX)
	set(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME "ffmpeg-linux")
elseif (MINGW)
	set(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME "ffmpeg-mingw")
else ()
	message(FATAL_ERROR "Unsupported OS.")
endif ()

# Detect Architecture
if(NOT DEFINED ARCHITECTURE)
	message(FATAL_ERROR "ARCHITECTURE variable is not set up")
elseif (ARCHITECTURE STREQUAL "x86_64")
	set(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME "${FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME}-x64.zip")
elseif(ARCHITECTURE STREQUAL "arm64")
	set(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME "${FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME}-arm64.zip")
elseif(APPLE AND "x86_64" IN_LIST ARCHITECTURE AND "arm64" IN_LIST ARCHITECTURE) # macOS universal
	set(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME "${FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME}-universal.zip")
else ()
	message(FATAL_ERROR "Unsupported architecture.")
endif()

# Prebuilt FFmpeg release tag. Pinned: this directory is vendored, so asking git for HEAD
# would return the parent repository's commit and break the download.
set(FFMPEG_GIT_SHA "9ac4cfd195f1")

# An existing package can be tested before publishing it.
set(FFMPEG_PREBUILT_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Directory containing an unpacked FFmpeg package")
if(NOT FFMPEG_PREBUILT_DIR)
	set(FFMPEG_PREBUILT_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/externals/ffmpeg-${FFMPEG_GIT_SHA}")
	set(FFMPEG_ZIP_PATH "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/externals/${FFMPEG_GIT_SHA}-${FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME}")
	if(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME STREQUAL "ffmpeg-windows-x64.zip")
		set(FFMPEG_SHA256 "32839a244a418063f6fb4bbe55585bc66ea17a859b920cae0e3aa1eab9398c09")
	elseif(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME STREQUAL "ffmpeg-windows-arm64.zip")
		set(FFMPEG_SHA256 "bf6347986ab50135fa379d5596b57fc29cdb7735f59adc2188871c52daee1267")
	elseif(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME STREQUAL "ffmpeg-macos-x64.zip")
		set(FFMPEG_SHA256 "b92c60ac99f9b2277f62d42e7424c24bc991d5723f4fa388a5d2e452be18f40b")
	elseif(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME STREQUAL "ffmpeg-macos-arm64.zip")
		set(FFMPEG_SHA256 "458933af900b2bf0bf3d4422e3ae1c7aef46f671cd4af99c42ffe99d43ca9170")
	elseif(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME STREQUAL "ffmpeg-macos-universal.zip")
		set(FFMPEG_SHA256 "4f7eccb838b0177cee9edbae671079888469e22044379516b95916c294b406e3")
	elseif(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME STREQUAL "ffmpeg-linux-x64.zip")
		set(FFMPEG_SHA256 "f4659ad09e6f2b99ecf0227ca56fe4bbb34572cdd8d85ff85384f74ba38f23ef")
	elseif(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME STREQUAL "ffmpeg-linux-arm64.zip")
		set(FFMPEG_SHA256 "01e39e8a20bbc6002cbe02024a357c39ec2104485bfee8e27a66b1d443e352a0")
	elseif(FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME STREQUAL "ffmpeg-mingw-x64.zip")
		set(FFMPEG_SHA256 "e4be9938b321da5f53e248d8ae947c984390e09d0f59fb6855644a972126e26b")
	else()
		message(FATAL_ERROR "No pinned SHA-256 for ${FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME}; add it to core/3rdparty/ffmpeg-core/CMakeLists.txt")
	endif()

	if(EXISTS "${FFMPEG_ZIP_PATH}")
		file(SHA256 "${FFMPEG_ZIP_PATH}" FFMPEG_HAVE_SHA256)
		if(NOT FFMPEG_HAVE_SHA256 STREQUAL "${FFMPEG_SHA256}")
			file(REMOVE "${FFMPEG_ZIP_PATH}")
			message(WARNING "Cached FFmpeg archive failed SHA-256 verification; re-acquiring it")
		endif()
	endif()

	if(NOT EXISTS "${FFMPEG_ZIP_PATH}")
		set(FFMPEG_DOWNLOAD_URL "https://github.com/KytyPS5/ext-ffmpeg-core/releases/download/${FFMPEG_GIT_SHA}/${FFMPEG_PREBUILTS_NAME}")
		set(FFMPEG_DOWNLOAD_OK FALSE)
		foreach(FFMPEG_ATTEMPT 1 2 3)
			message(STATUS "Downloading FFmpeg libraries (attempt ${FFMPEG_ATTEMPT})...")
			file(DOWNLOAD "${FFMPEG_DOWNLOAD_URL}" "${FFMPEG_ZIP_PATH}"
				TIMEOUT 600 SHOW_PROGRESS STATUS FFMPEG_DOWNLOAD_STATUS)
			list(GET FFMPEG_DOWNLOAD_STATUS 0 FFMPEG_DOWNLOAD_CODE)
			if(FFMPEG_DOWNLOAD_CODE EQUAL 0)
				file(SHA256 "${FFMPEG_ZIP_PATH}" FFMPEG_HAVE_SHA256)
				if(FFMPEG_HAVE_SHA256 STREQUAL "${FFMPEG_SHA256}")
					set(FFMPEG_DOWNLOAD_OK TRUE)
					break()
				endif()
				file(REMOVE "${FFMPEG_ZIP_PATH}")
				message(WARNING "FFmpeg download failed SHA-256 verification (attempt ${FFMPEG_ATTEMPT})")
			else()
				list(GET FFMPEG_DOWNLOAD_STATUS 1 FFMPEG_DOWNLOAD_MESSAGE)
				file(REMOVE "${FFMPEG_ZIP_PATH}")
				message(WARNING "FFmpeg download failed (attempt ${FFMPEG_ATTEMPT}): ${FFMPEG_DOWNLOAD_MESSAGE}")
			endif()
			if(NOT FFMPEG_ATTEMPT EQUAL 3)
				execute_process(COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E sleep 10)
			endif()
		endforeach()
		if(NOT FFMPEG_DOWNLOAD_OK)
			message(FATAL_ERROR "Could not acquire a verified FFmpeg ${FFMPEG_GIT_SHA} archive (expected SHA-256 ${FFMPEG_SHA256}); pass FFMPEG_PREBUILT_DIR to supply one manually")
		endif()
	endif()
	if(NOT EXISTS "${FFMPEG_PREBUILT_DIR}/include/libavcodec/avcodec.h")
		file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${FFMPEG_PREBUILT_DIR}")
		execute_process(COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E tar xf "${FFMPEG_ZIP_PATH}"
			WORKING_DIRECTORY "${FFMPEG_PREBUILT_DIR}" RESULT_VARIABLE FFMPEG_EXTRACT_RESULT)
		if(NOT FFMPEG_EXTRACT_RESULT EQUAL 0)
			message(FATAL_ERROR "Could not extract FFmpeg libraries")
		endif()
	endif()
endif()
set(FFMPEG_LIB_PATH "${FFMPEG_PREBUILT_DIR}/lib")
if(NOT EXISTS "${FFMPEG_PREBUILT_DIR}/include/libavcodec/avcodec.h")
	message(FATAL_ERROR "FFmpeg package headers are missing")
endif()
target_include_directories(${FFMPEG_CORE_NAME} INTERFACE "${FFMPEG_PREBUILT_DIR}/include")
install(DIRECTORY "${FFMPEG_PREBUILT_DIR}/share/ffmpeg/" DESTINATION "licenses/ffmpeg")

set(LIB_PREFIX "lib")
set(LIB_EXT "a")
if (WIN32 AND NOT MINGW)
	set(LIB_PREFIX "")
	set(LIB_EXT "lib")
	target_link_libraries(${FFMPEG_CORE_NAME} INTERFACE
		"psapi;strmiids;uuid;oleaut32;shlwapi;ws2_32;ole32;user32;bcrypt")
elseif (APPLE)
	target_link_libraries(${FFMPEG_CORE_NAME} INTERFACE
		"-framework CoreServices" "-framework CoreFoundation" "-framework AudioUnit"
		"-framework AudioToolbox" "-framework CoreAudio" "-framework CoreMedia"
		"-framework VideoToolbox" "-framework CoreVideo" "-framework Security")
endif ()

foreach(FFMPEG_LIB avformat avcodec swscale avutil avfilter swresample)
	set(FFMPEG_LIB_FILE "${FFMPEG_LIB_PATH}/${LIB_PREFIX}${FFMPEG_LIB}.${LIB_EXT}")
	if(NOT EXISTS "${FFMPEG_LIB_FILE}")
		message(FATAL_ERROR "FFmpeg package is incomplete: ${FFMPEG_LIB_FILE} is missing")
	endif()
	file(SIZE "${FFMPEG_LIB_FILE}" FFMPEG_LIB_SIZE)
	if(FFMPEG_LIB_SIZE EQUAL 0)
		message(FATAL_ERROR "FFmpeg package is incomplete: ${FFMPEG_LIB_FILE} is empty")
	endif()
endforeach()

target_link_libraries(${FFMPEG_CORE_NAME} INTERFACE
	"${FFMPEG_LIB_PATH}/${LIB_PREFIX}avformat.${LIB_EXT}"
	"${FFMPEG_LIB_PATH}/${LIB_PREFIX}avcodec.${LIB_EXT}"
	"${FFMPEG_LIB_PATH}/${LIB_PREFIX}swscale.${LIB_EXT}"
	"${FFMPEG_LIB_PATH}/${LIB_PREFIX}avutil.${LIB_EXT}"
	"${FFMPEG_LIB_PATH}/${LIB_PREFIX}avfilter.${LIB_EXT}"
	"${FFMPEG_LIB_PATH}/${LIB_PREFIX}swresample.${LIB_EXT}")

if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
	find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
	target_link_libraries(${FFMPEG_CORE_NAME} INTERFACE m Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
endif()
